Build an English booking landing page for Harbor Wheel Workshop, a fictional
bicycle tune-up service. The audience is local cycle commuters arriving via a
neighborhood email. The offer is a 30-minute safety tune-up, with a brake,
chain and tire check. Use a wordmark and an editorial workbench feel with navy,
warm white and copper. The primary action is “Request a tune-up”. Build or
connect the local form using the provided fixture server. The test endpoint
accepts JSON via POST /api/booking with fields `email` and `slot`. The available
slot is `saturday-10`. A slot of `saturday-11` produces a test service error.
Use only synthetic emails. Check empty, invalid, success and service-error
states. Include a clear motion or interaction cue where useful and a reduced
motion treatment. This is a private preview with no production URL. Deliver
Markdown and JSON.
